why: Found by I119 itself on the counted audit run (results/M6/I119/audit.json), after the run finished; scored as a miss of I119-P3 (7 of 8, not 8). Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for. The test assumed every committed Morph Go document is the raw output of holon extract go. spec/M3/facts/morph_derivation.extracted.json is not: it is spec/M2/lib/go_frontend.json's morph_derivation document with a 'consumer' section added on top by I85's derivation consumer (holon-derivation-consumer/0.1). Every other top-level key is equal to the M2 document's, and that document re-extracts byte-identical under the old reading. The amended check compares a document whose committed bytes carry a consumer section by its extractor part (the document without 'consumer', canonical JSON) with the baseline extraction. That part must be equal, and so must every other document's bytes. The claim (the old reading reproduces what the extractor committed, so the audit compares like with like) is unchanged.
